about: Limits for make bench BENCH_CHECK=1 (tools/bench.py), per campaign level and per frame. Times are milliseconds measured by the Bench workflow on a GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner (x86_64, headless Memory backend, release build); an Apple M-series Mac takes about a third of that. Shared runners vary from run to run, so a level fails only above tolerance x budget. Texture switches are the same on every machine, so their tolerance is tight. Lower a budget when an optimization lands; raise one only with the reason in the commit message.
